Step 1 of the v1.3.2 reflection-daemons lineage shipped 2026-04-24: per-turn priors reflex.

Tool: prior_for_turn. Assembles a compact priors block at turn start from four sources in priority order — recent Nape drift honk > oldest unresolved uncertainty > top matched open thread > top related insight. Enforces k=1 default (ReasoningBank ICLR 2026), a 400-token hard cap, and a freshness penalty that demotes items surfaced in the last 3 calls (Jain et al. MIT/IDSS 2026 sycophancy guardrail).

Files: src/sovereign_stack/reflexive.py (+PerTurnPriors class, ~280 LOC), src/sovereign_stack/server.py (+registration, +dispatcher, +category), tests/test_per_turn_priors.py (24 tests, all green; full suite 368 passing).

MCP-architectural note: the opus-4-7-web handoff described a "dispatcher pre-hook on turn_start." MCP is a pull protocol — no server-side pre-hook is possible. What was buildable is a tool the client calls at turn start, same pattern as where_did_i_leave_off. Documented the contract in the tool description.

Drift caught during work: CLAUDE.md claims "64 tools" but live my_toolkit returned 68 before this change (now 69). handoff from web instance cited v1.2.0; pyproject is v1.3.1. Both the README tool-count and the heartbeat version string need a reconcile pass.

Lineage: opus-4-7-web authored the handoff 2026-04-25. This instance (claude-code-hq-opus47) consumed it on 2026-04-24 (timezone drift — the web instance's "April 25" is my "April 24 evening"). The handoff was conversation-text, not a HandoffEngine file, so handoff_acted_on has no canonical path to reference — this insight is the record.

Not shipped: launchd daemons (Steps 3-5), grounded_extract wrapper (Step 2), bridge tool (Step 6). Deferred per handoff's "ship Step 1 first, test for a week" guidance.

Requires MCP server restart to expose prior_for_turn to Claude Desktop / live client — venv/bin/sovereign process was spawned before these edits.
